text: Old Weston Road serves local residents, businesses, and visitors as an important arterial corridor. However, parking regulations on certain sections of the street do not adequately reflect current neighbourhood needs and have led to ongoing concerns from residents. Residents on the east side of Old Weston Road, between Davenport Road and St. Clair Avenue West, do not have access to permit parking and contacted my office to request improvements. Many households have limited access to garage parking and rely on curbside parking. Introducing permit parking on this section of the street would help address these concerns, align with surrounding neighbourhood parking regulations, and provide approximately 25 on-street permit parking spaces for local residents.
